# PhysicsWorld

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** both · **Folder:** [`src/physics/`](../folders/src-physics.md)
> **Source:** [`src/physics/physics_world.h`](../../../src/physics/physics_world.h), [`src/physics/physics_world.cpp`](../../../src/physics/physics_world.cpp)

## Summary

A Jolt PhysicsSystem with its job system and temp allocator, one per registry.

## Description

World registries get it in the World constructor from the template's "physics" block (PhysicsConfig via physicsConfig(def)). The host registry gets the default PhysicsConfig the first time physicsWorld(reg) is called (preinit of RigidBodySys / TerrainCollidersSys / PhysicsSys / PhysicsStepSys / WorldTerrainSys). Requires a live JoltRuntime (logs critical otherwise). threads == 1 uses JobSystemSingleThreaded; otherwise a JobSystemThreadPool of `threads` threads, or hardware_concurrency/2 - 1 (min 1) when threads == 0. Object layers: static(0), moving(1), agent(2), sensor(3); static collides with moving and agent, moving with everything, agent with sensor; broad phase non_moving (static layer) and moving (everything else). step(dt) calls PhysicsSystem::Update(dt, 1 collision step). Query helpers groundBelow / castStatic / sphereContact only hit the static layer and use the NoLock interfaces (outside the step only). Friction/restitution combine rules Geometric (Jolt default), Max or Min. Non-copyable.

## Scene JSON

world template "physics": { threads, max_bodies, max_body_pairs, max_contacts, temp_bytes, gravity, substeps, allow_sleeping, friction_combine, restitution_combine, velocity_steps, position_steps, speculative_distance, penetration_slop } (parsed by physicsConfig in src/scene/world.cpp)
